tracking: ADR-0328 (lane E12): the brief is API and backend only; the repetitive-ask page (clusters, suggested agent, savings, dismiss, settings) is for UI-D

gaps.GET /v1/repetitive-asks/settings: reads the repetitive-ask detection switch and thresholds, with the strict defaults and floors
gaps.PUT /v1/repetitive-asks/settings: turns repetitive-ask detection on or off or changes its thresholds (enabling or relaxing one is a settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.POST /v1/repetitive-asks/scan: scans recent model spans for clusters of near-duplicate prompts and stores them with a suggested cheaper agent (read-only, no prompt text kept, spaced 10 minutes, audited)
gaps.GET /v1/repetitive-asks/clusters: lists repetitive-ask clusters with their evidence, the suggested cheaper agent and the projected monthly saving, under the ADR-0226 list contract
